lokal-home-dnd-codex:
• PROPOSED

  Revised snap mechanism: HQ keeps free horizontal positioning on its own row and snaps only to a fine invisible 8px
  grid. This preserves JROM’s Option A “free reign” behavior while still giving clean, deterministic snap/persist
  behavior.

  Implementation detail for onHqDragEnded:

  rawX = event.source.getFreeDragPosition().x;
  clampedX = clamp(rawX, 0, usableWidth);
  snappedX = Math.round(clampedX / 8) * 8;
  snappedFraction = usableWidth > 0 ? snappedX / usableWidth : 0.5;
  event.source.setFreeDragPosition({ x: snappedX, y: 0 });

  Then set hqOffset to snappedFraction and debounce setHomeHqOffset(snappedFraction) by ~500ms. I’ll document this 8px
  snap choice and rationale in batch-6/changes.md per A15.

  Everything else remains as previously proposed: ViewChild geometry readiness, cdkDragLockAxis="x",
  cdkDragBoundary=".hq-section", click preservation, SCSS boundary positioning, and no backend/service changes.

  STATUS: PROPOSED — revised to 8px invisible-grid snap per JROM Option A.
